notes.title: Update 1.1.X - balance and optimizations
notes.content:
Mainly tried to improve frame rate when hitting higher levels, where many more enemies spawn.

Changed some balancing to scale difficulty at later levels.

Nerfed the gargoyle at earlier levels.

notes.title: Update v1.0.3
notes.content:
Some updates!

[list]
[*] changed the 3X time speed to be 4X
[*] Increased starting mana from 100 to 120
[*] Buffed Spell Duelist Major artifact to also give 50 max mana
[*] New enemy type: big gargoyle. It's bigger, armored, flies! However, must slower movement.
[*] Nerfed armor melting so all enemies regain 1 armor every 2 seconds instead of 3 seconds. Forces you to place multiple armor melting towers in your path.
[*] Ability to always show damage counters so you dont need to hold down ALT all the time
[/list]
